title: Daily Workout · November 15
note: Sunday · approximately 46 minutes: six established opening stretches (6 min), calorie-focused incline treadmill walking (35 min), and gentle posture practice (5 min). Recovery from Saturday core session: no additional core or dumbbell strength today. Maintain steady fixed 3% incline and 2%/4% intervals every 3 minutes, walking only up to 4.2 mph, no jogging. The user is trying Topo Athletic Phantom 4 Men's 10.5 Wide; introduce cautiously at a comfortable pace and watch for tingling, and return to previously comfortable footwear if symptoms appear. Older HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E) has 850+ miles and needs replacement; avoid only New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v15 due to reported tingling, not the entire brand. Stop for tingling, numbness, painful heel strikes or sharp lumbar pain. Avoid forced lumbar extension. Preserve all six opening stretches and original timers. Plow pose with feet suspended remains listed as user preference but skip unless medically cleared due to neck/spine loading. Its floor-contact photograph is reference-only, not an exact depiction. No actual exercise performance or loads assumed.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight, other foot beside buttock; lean back with arm support only if comfortable. Skip if it provokes lumbar or knee pain. Use existing StretchCoach image registry entry.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Soles together, sit upright, do not force knees down. One 60-second hold, not separate left/right holds.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Use comfortable, controlled motion. Do not force rotation or continue if it provokes sharp back pain.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Straight legs with feet suspended, not touching floor. Advanced neck/spine-loading inversion; do not perform without clearance for current lumbar symptoms. Existing photograph showing floor contact is reference-only.

items.name: Arm circles
items.instructions: Gentle circles, comfortable range; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Overhead triceps stretch
items.instructions: Gentle overhead stretch without forcing the shoulder or arching the back; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: For the new Topo Athletic Phantom 4 Men's 10.5 Wide, begin at a comfortable pace and check toe room, pressure, and tingling. If symptoms develop, stop; the older HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E) was previously comfortable but is worn out. Avoid the New Balance 1080 v15 specifically, not all New Balance models.

items.name: Steady brisk walk
items.instructions: Maintain a constant 3% incline for the entire steady segment. If testing the new Topo Phantom 4, first confirm comfort at lower speed and incline before progressing; walk naturally, reduce speed if needed, stop for tingling.

items.name: Incline walking intervals
items.detail: 15 min · 3.6–4.2 mph · alternate 2% and 4% incline every 3 min
items.instructions: Three-minute blocks at 2%, 4%, 2%, 4%, 2%. Brisk walking only, no jogging. Progress only if the new shoe feels comfortable; stop if tingling or back pain returns.

items.name: Cool-down walk
items.instructions: Gradually ease down to a comfortable pace.

items.name: Band pull-aparts
items.instructions: Use your separate light rubber PT resistance band, held freely in both hands at chest height, not wall anchored. Keep elbows softly bent, gently pull apart and squeeze shoulder blades, return slowly. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis, avoid shrugging or backward lean. Stop if painful.

items.name: Chin tucks
items.instructions: Eyes level, draw chin straight backward gently without tipping head up or down; relax between repetitions.

items.name: Wall-anchored band chest stretch
items.detail: 60 sec · 30 sec each side · light tension
items.instructions: Use the securely mounted wall resistance band anchor near shoulder height. Face away from the anchor and hold band with one hand; step forward gently for a mild chest stretch. Keep ribs stacked over pelvis, shoulder relaxed, lumbar spine neutral. Change sides at 30 sec; no doorway needed. Stop if painful.

items.name: Wall angels
items.instructions: Back to wall with feet slightly forward; keep neutral spine, chin gently tucked, ribs down. Slowly move arms between comfortable V and W positions without forcing contact or lumbar flattening. Stop for shoulder, neck, or back discomfort.
